Our Services

We help communities, municipalities, and organisations design better cities — together.

Participation That Creates Real Change

City Layers combines digital innovation with deep urban planning expertise to make community participation meaningful, inclusive, and impactful. We work with cities, municipalities, developers, and civic organisations across Europe to ensure that the people most affected by urban decisions have a genuine voice in shaping them.

Our services span the full lifecycle of urban participation — from designing engagement strategies and running digital consultations, to analysing community data and translating insights into actionable recommendations for decision-makers.

Services overview image

What We Do

Digital Community Engagement

We design and run digital participation processes that reach the full diversity of your community — not just the usual voices. Using our platform, residents can share ideas, respond to proposals, and map their lived experiences directly onto your project area.

Our engagement tools are accessible across devices, available in multiple languages, and designed to be intuitive for people of all ages and technical backgrounds.

  • Interactive mapping and spatial feedback
  • Custom surveys and idea boards
  • Multi-language participation support
  • Accessible design for all community members
Community engagement image

Data Analysis & Insight Reporting

Raw participation data only has value when it can be understood and acted upon. Our team of urban analysts and data scientists transform community responses into clear, evidence-based insights that support confident decision-making.

We go beyond basic statistics — identifying spatial patterns, sentiment trends, and underrepresented perspectives to give you a complete picture of your community's priorities.

  • AI-powered theme and sentiment analysis
  • Spatial heat maps and geographic insights
  • Stakeholder-ready summary reports
  • Natural language querying of your data
Data analysis image

Participation Strategy & Facilitation

Effective participation doesn't happen by accident. We work with your team from the outset to design a participation strategy that is proportionate to your project, meaningful for your community, and defensible to your stakeholders.

Our experienced facilitators can run workshops, public events, and stakeholder sessions — either in person or digitally — ensuring every voice is heard and recorded.

  • Participation strategy development
  • Workshop design and facilitation
  • Stakeholder mapping and engagement planning
  • Public consultation management
Facilitation image

Platform Licensing & Technical Integration

For organisations that want to run participation processes independently, we offer City Layers as a licensed platform. Our team handles onboarding, training, and ongoing technical support — so your team can focus on engaging your community, not managing software.

We also offer API access and custom integrations for organisations that need to connect City Layers with existing planning tools, GIS systems, or internal dashboards.

  • Platform licensing for municipalities and consultancies
  • Team training and onboarding
  • API access and custom integrations
  • White-label options available
Platform image
